newsitem.title: INDIA: India releases 345,000 bales of cotton for export.
newsitem.headline: India releases 345,000 bales of cotton for export.

text.p: The Indian government on Monday released a quota of 345,000 bales of cotton for export, a Textiles Ministry statement said.
"It is stipulated that the cotton exported should be of the 1996/97 (Sept-Aug) crop," the statement said.
It said the release was in addition to a export quota of 150,000 bales for Bengal Deshi crop announced earlier.

The statement said Monday's quota was for export by various state marketing federations, Cotton Corporation of India, National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation (NAFED) and the private trade.
